column1: # Local subscribed source 2997006603, numeric version 2. Music title fields included.
Adds Dwarven Music (2012) and Songs of Saltfork (2015) by Simon Swerwer to the in-game music rotation, originally appearing in the SoundSense utilty.
column2: 将 Simon Swerwer 的《矮人音乐》（2012）与《盐叉之歌》（2015）加入游戏音乐轮播。这些曲目最初收录于 SoundSense 工具。
